features.name: Provision Peer Device
features.note: Migrated Scenario1.xaml is byte-identical to the UWP source. Structural coverage 2/3: Browse present & functional (opens the .ppkg file picker; +81 text tokens), Transfer matched, Cancel Transfer absent. Transfer and Cancel Transfer are Visibility=Collapsed / NFC-hardware-gated in BOTH the UWP golden and the WinUI app, so their absence from the initial-state capture is not a migration regression and there are no dead controls (0 behavioral regressions). Verdict held at partial rather than pass because the WinUI window screenshots blank/white (a WinUI 3 DirectComposition GDI-capture limitation) so full visual parity could not be positively confirmed, even though the UIA tree shows all controls laid out on-screen and Browse works.
